start: ^Vega: Hey. You're looking at the person-chat view -- my portrait fills the screen, and your dialogue runs along the bottom.
^Vega: This is how you talk to anyone standing in the same room as you.
^How is this different from the phone?

c-0: ^Vega: The phone-chat view is a texting UI -- message bubbles, no portraits. Two contacts are already on the phones in your inventory. Open one.
c-1: ^Vega: See the console blinking in the corner? Read it. Someone wants a video call -- that's the third style.

c-0: ^You: Like this -- when I reply, the caption switches to me and my name turns orange.
^Vega: Exactly. Portrait for me, caption for you.
